hero.eyebrow: The archive · eight bodies of work
hero.title: αλήθεια
hero.intro: Aletheia. Greek: truth as unconcealment rather than correctness. My own name for the collection, used as a tag in my private archive for years.

entries.title: The Treatise
entries.excerpt: A treatise on sound, vibration, consciousness, and dimensional shadow, plus the pieces around it.

entries.title: Inner Work
entries.excerpt: Inner and outer reality as reflections of each other. Long, and the only piece here that names its own failure mode.

entries.title: Essence
entries.excerpt: Absolute truth as a coin whose other side is disgust. On being “mocked and ridiculed and mercilessly reduced to void” by the same essence that later completes you.

entries.title: Complexes and Addiction
entries.excerpt: A subpersonality relaying information to the ego, and the urgency it manufactures being “literally chemically addicting.” Ends at “an addiction encouraged by an identity.”

entries.title: Symbol and Archetype
entries.excerpt: The Athena statue: Medusa as chaos consuming you until you are frozen to stone, Athena as integration, Nike as what comes from taming chaos.
entries.annotation: Annotation — “I made up the following and do not know Greek mythology, but this is what I want to see”

entries.title: Time and Synchronicity
entries.excerpt: A two-dimensional bug crossing sheets of paper it cannot perceive as separate, while a three-dimensional observer sees the whole stack at once.

entries.title: Power and Attention
entries.excerpt: A talk on AI and the totalitarian state, and an academic paper on Appiah and cultural imperialism.

entries.title: Early Work
entries.excerpt: A time-travel plot written in the Notes app. Juvenilia, kept because it is where the arc starts.
entries.annotation: Framing — “A way for my brain to express its chaos, aka art”
